preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: 1 <= R, G, B, M <= 100
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of potions R, G, B, and the number of magic tricks M are between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: 1 <= r[i], g[i], b[i] <= 10^9
preconditions.description: The amount of liquid in each potion r[i], g[i], b[i] is between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: return_value == min(max(r), max(g), max(b)) after performing at most M magic tricks
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the minimum possible value of the maximum amount of liquid among all potions after performing at most M magic tricks.
